title: Clear Kayak Glow in the Dark Tour Through Winter Park
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Weight limit is no more than 250 pounds per paddler. We also have a combined limit of no more than 425 pounds for both paddlers in a kayak.
Each minor (under 18) must be accompanied in a kayak with an adult (18+)
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Be ready for a glow in the dark paddling excursion that will showcase Winter Park’s natural beauty from the water and lead guests through the night. Enjoy the glow from our LED equipped kayaks as we’ll guide the way through narrow Venetian style canals laced with history and lined with some of Florida’s finest flora and fauna.

Plenty of birds, fish, and other wildlife will no doubt make an appearance, along with the extravagant houses that are nestled among the lakes.
